info.name: EventMitra - Booking and Notifications
info.description: Apply migrations 016/017. Run folders individually with your existing user, venue owner and admin. Keep cookies enabled. Select a future date and valid slot-linked price from venue detail. Payment comes AFTER owner acceptance and collects configured advances only. Real Checkout runs in the frontend, then paste its callback values into the environment. Refund examples are skipped unless run_refund_examples=true. FCM registration is skipped until real tokens are set. No provider secrets belong in this collection. Full setup: docs/booking-api.md. Migration 018: owner signup requires unique user_name; owner_name may repeat. Login uses email or user_name. Verification purpose OTP creates a bearer session; password-reset proof does not. Migration 019 adds venue_address. Shared authenticated multipart upload: POST /api/uploads. Migration 020 adds is_default (false on insert), one fallback per venue/slot, and booking_date price resolution for user venue search/detail, quote and creation. Full endpoint changes: docs/default-venue-pricing.md.

exec: // Resolve variables inside parsed JSON, preserving quotes/backslashes in private inputs.

const replace = value => typeof value === "string" ? pm.variables.replaceIn(value) : Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(replace) : value && typeof value === "object" ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [key, replace(item)])) : value;

item.name: 01 - Authenticate existing user, owner and admin

request.description: Development authentication uses OTP 1111. Use the separate User collection to sign up first if needed.

exec: if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const data = pm.response.json().data; const value = data.otp_token; if (value) pm.environment.set('otp_token', value); }

item.name: Verify user OTP - creates user session

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json().data; if (data.access_token) pm.environment.set('owner_access_token', data.access_token); }

item.name: Get chosen venue and its bookable price/slot/package IDs

request.description: Inspect data.venue_price_details. Set booking_venue_price_id to a price valid on booking_date. No private owner data is returned. With booking_date, data includes effective date-specific prices or slot defaults, price_source and has_price_for_date. Choose a returned venue_price_id; defaults ignore their stored venue date range.
Edit guest_count and optional package flags in BOTH quote and creation. The server returns total, advance and balance; quote does not reserve.

Same body + same key safely retries. Clear booking_idempotency_key before creating another intended booking. Blank contact email is omitted; required when profile has no email. IDs and amounts come from server.

exec: if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const data = pm.response.json().data; const value = data.booking_id; if (value) pm.environment.set('booking_id', value); }

item.name: 08 - OPTIONAL rejection and admin refund approval
item.description: Run only on an intentional test booking. Set run_refund_examples=true. A paid rejection opens review; approval queues a real provider refund through the worker. Never run this folder casually on production.

item.name: Owner reject - paid booking requires refund review

exec: if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const data = pm.response.json().data; const value = data.refund_reviews.find(row => row.status === 'Pending')?.refund_review_id; if (value) pm.environment.set('refund_review_id', value); }

item.name: Admin approve refund - worker processes after review

request.description: Requires booking_management Edit. Change decision to reject to decline. Approved does not mean processed; worker/provider completion determines final state.
